_comment: MAINNET plugin config. chainId 29 is canoLiq's registered committee id. activationHeight=1 is the safe default for a fresh graduation: every later validator replays the same plugin genesis at block 1. The already-running committee 29 must override it with CANOLIQ_ACTIVATION_HEIGHT set to an agreed future block on every validator; height 1 has already passed there. This is NOT the node's own chain id and must not be copied into CANOLIQCTL_CHAIN_ID. profile=mainnet enables every startup guard.
